src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2020_us_cd116_500k
cd.vint: The Census Bureau's lines of the 116th Congress's districts (its file says session 116). The Bureau published no file of the 117th Congress's districts, the Congress the 2020 election chose.
rec: 2012 congressional plan drawn by a three-judge federal court (Essex v. Kobach, No. 5:12-cv-4046, D. Kan.)

Federal Judicial Center, Case Studies in Emergency Election Litigation: Redistricting Kansas (Essex v. Kobach, No. 5:12-cv-4046, 874 F. Supp. 2d 1069 (D. Kan. 2012)): a three-judge court issued new lines for Congress, the legislature and the state board of education on June 7, 2012

No plan was enacted in time; the court issued the lines late on June 7, 2012 (opinion 874 F. Supp. 2d 1069) ahead of the June 11 filing deadline. Four districts; used for 2012 through 2020. Census check: cb_2020_us_cd116 (CDSESSN 116; lines supplied by the states by May 1, 2018) holds this plan; 4 of 4 districts differ in shape from the 2022 file, as a new plan should.

src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2020_us_sldu_500k
sldu.vint: The Census Bureau's 2020 file of legislative districts, the lines it records for the 2018 legislative session year. The Bureau published no file of the lines in use for 2020. Where a state's lines changed in between, the check below or the plan cited stops the map.
rec: 2012 state Senate plan drawn by a three-judge federal court (Essex v. Kobach, No. 5:12-cv-4046, D. Kan.): 40 districts

Federal Judicial Center, Case Studies in Emergency Election Litigation: Redistricting Kansas (Essex v. Kobach, No. 5:12-cv-4046, 874 F. Supp. 2d 1069 (D. Kan. 2012)): a three-judge court issued new lines for Congress, the legislature and the state board of education on June 7, 2012

Court-drawn lines for both legislative houses and the state board of education, announced June 7, 2012. Kansas elects its Senate in presidential years, so these lines were used in 2012, 2016 and 2020. Census check: cb_2020_us_sldu (LSY 2018, 40 districts; boundaries collected for the 2018 election year) holds this plan, which was unchanged to November 2020; 38 of 40 districts differ in shape from the 2022 file.

src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2020_us_sldl_500k
sldl.vint: The Census Bureau's 2020 file of legislative districts, the lines it records for the 2018 legislative session year. The Bureau published no file of the lines in use for 2020. Where a state's lines changed in between, the check below or the plan cited stops the map.
rec: 2012 state House plan drawn by a three-judge federal court (Essex v. Kobach, No. 5:12-cv-4046, D. Kan.): 125 districts

Federal Judicial Center, Case Studies in Emergency Election Litigation: Redistricting Kansas (Essex v. Kobach, No. 5:12-cv-4046, 874 F. Supp. 2d 1069 (D. Kan. 2012)): a three-judge court issued new lines for Congress, the legislature and the state board of education on June 7, 2012

Court-drawn lines announced June 7, 2012; used for the 2012 through 2020 elections. Census check: cb_2020_us_sldl (LSY 2018, 125 districts; boundaries collected for the 2018 election year) holds this plan, which was unchanged to November 2020; 117 of 125 districts differ in shape from the 2022 file.
